enablers.title: Validate preparation effort
enablers.body: Observe how Gilbert finds materials, prepares and follows up. Establish a baseline before claiming that the workflow saves time.
enablers.check: Compare the same teaching task before and after; record effort and teacher control.

enablers.title: Profile draft storage
enablers.body: Store and retrieve the teacher’s offer and revisions. Keep a draft distinct from a live profile; simulated checks cannot grant approval.
enablers.check: Reopen the saved offer and verify it matches the teacher’s edits.

enablers.title: Learner-linked brief access
enablers.body: Link each concise brief to the correct teacher and learner. Make the goal, level and current difficulty available for preparation.
enablers.check: Open the correct brief; deny access from an unrelated teacher.

enablers.title: Reusable lesson data model
enablers.body: Separate a reusable source from its learner-specific editable version. Keep the source and the teacher’s method intact during adaptation.
enablers.check: Adapt one lesson and confirm that its reusable original is unchanged.

enablers.title: Approval and version states
enablers.body: Track draft and approved versions. Require review of the current content; changed or unreviewed drafts cannot be shared as approved.
enablers.check: Edit an approved version and confirm that review is required again.

enablers.title: Session and material linkage
enablers.body: Open the right learner’s reviewed plan for the session. Support changes while teaching without losing the current lesson context.
enablers.check: Change the plan during a session and retain the correct learner and materials.

enablers.title: Reviewed recap delivery
enablers.body: Link the recap draft to its session and learner. Record the teacher’s review and the result of an explicit sharing action.
enablers.check: A failed send stays unsent; a successful share reaches only the intended learner.

enablers.title: Optional AI integration and evaluation
enablers.body: Keep suggested content separate from the lesson until Gilbert chooses it. Evaluate relevance and accuracy; provide edit, reject and manual paths.
enablers.check: Try an unsuitable suggestion and an unavailable AI service. Neither bypasses approval or blocks manual preparation.

nfrs.title: Accessibility
nfrs.body: Gilbert can read, navigate, edit, review and share with keyboard and assistive technology. Focus, labels and errors remain clear.
nfrs.check: Complete profile → brief → lesson → approval → recap using keyboard and screen reader.

nfrs.title: Low-effort usability
nfrs.body: Briefs, lesson edits and recaps stay concise. Reuse reduces repeated entry while Gilbert keeps his method and final judgment.
nfrs.check: Observe Gilbert’s full task; compare preparation and follow-up effort with the EN07 baseline.

nfrs.title: Performance during teaching
nfrs.body: Opening the brief or plan, editing content and confirming actions stays responsive enough to preserve attention during the lesson.
nfrs.check: Measure these actions on agreed devices and network conditions; set targets after baseline testing.

nfrs.title: Web and mobile consistency
nfrs.body: The same offer, goal, lesson version and approval meaning remain usable on both journey touchpoints. Small screens do not hide controls.
nfrs.check: Run the same core task in web and phone layouts, including zoom and keyboard-open states.

nfrs.title: Draft and version reliability
nfrs.body: Acknowledged saves recover after refresh or disruption. Reuse preserves originals; approved content and sharing status remain accurate.
nfrs.check: Interrupt edits and sharing, reload and retry; verify recovered content and no duplicate share.

nfrs.title: Privacy and data minimization
nfrs.body: Only intended teaching-profile content is public. Learner briefs, lesson drafts and recaps remain limited to their intended use and recipients.
nfrs.check: Inspect profile and learner-facing outputs for unintended private data; check stored and logged fields.

nfrs.title: Authorization and isolation
nfrs.body: Teachers can change only their own offer and access only authorized learners, lessons and recaps. Recipients are checked at sharing time.
nfrs.check: Attempt cross-teacher reads, edits and recap delivery; each unauthorized request must be denied.

nfrs.title: Human control and transparency
nfrs.body: AI remains optional and recognizable. Gilbert can edit or reject suggestions, adapt the plan and approve the exact version before sharing.
nfrs.check: Follow manual and AI paths; verify that no suggestion or unreviewed draft is automatically shared.

nfrs.title: Availability and recovery
nfrs.body: Optional AI failure does not block manual preparation or access to saved material. Failed sharing gives a clear outcome and retry path.
nfrs.check: Disable optional services and interrupt delivery; verify manual work and draft recovery remain available.

nfrs.title: Maintainability and verification
nfrs.body: Web and mobile use consistent rules for learner linkage, reusable versions, approval and recap delivery as the product changes.
nfrs.check: Run shared rule checks for source preservation, approval invalidation, access and intended-recipient delivery.
